description: This Java class 'DefaultPayloadPathMatcher' provides utility methods for matching JSON pointer paths against configured regex patterns to identify entities in payloads. It supports creation of matchers with specific patterns or an empty matcher, and it throws an exception if a path does not match any pattern.

classes.name: DefaultPayloadPathMatcher
classes.description: A final class implementing PayloadPathMatcher, encapsulating a map of pattern entries for matching JSON path strings.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a new PayloadPathMatcher instance with a given map of patterns.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates a PayloadPathMatcher that matches no patterns.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches a JSONPointer path against known patterns to find an entity name, throws exception if no match.
